meta_description: Control a Bananasome Dragon S1 ring or a DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 e-stim unit from your browser over Bluetooth. No sign-up. Your usage history stays in your browser.

data_lede: Usage history and settings stay in this browser, with no uploads or sign-up.

safety_estim_what: E-stim is gentle electrical stimulation through the ring.
safety_estim_medical: Do not use e-stim with a pacemaker, other implanted device, heart condition or epilepsy.
safety_estim_below_waist: Use e-stim below the waist only.
safety_never_sleeping: Never use the ring while sleeping or driving.
safety_stop_hurts: If anything hurts or feels wrong, press Stop now. If output continues, switch off the device itself.
about_what: Control DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 and Bananasome Dragon S1 over Bluetooth in your browser.
welcome_what: Control DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 and Bananasome Dragon S1 over Bluetooth in your browser.
welcome_connect_lede: Switch your device on and keep it close to this phone or computer.
preset_steady_desc: Constant vibration. Use the vibration intensity control to adjust its strength.
preset_slow_pulse_desc: One second on, one second off.
preset_quick_pulse_desc: Vibration switches on and off 2.5 times a second.
preset_knock_desc: One firm knock, then three lighter ones.
preset_heartbeat_desc: A lub-dub double beat at about 70 per minute.
preset_breath_desc: Slow breathing. It rises for 4 s and eases off for 6 s, about 6 breaths a minute.
preset_tide_desc: Vibration rises, dips slightly, rises again, then falls.
preset_wave_desc: Vibration rises and falls smoothly every 4 seconds, up to your chosen intensity.
preset_stroke_desc: Quick, rounded waves of vibration, about 1.4 per second.
preset_climb_desc: Rises steadily for 6 s, stops, and climbs again.
preset_waterfall_desc: Up for 4 s, down for 4 s.
preset_staircase_desc: Six vibration levels, each 25 % stronger and lasting 8 seconds, then a brief pause before repeating.
preset_build_desc: Vibration gets stronger over 90 seconds as pulses speed up from 0.5 to 3 per second. After a peak, it pauses for 20 seconds.
preset_tease_desc: Builds for 20 s, hovers near the top for 10 s, then stops for 15 s.
preset_rhythm_desc: Five vibration pulses across eight steps at about 110 bpm, with long and short spacing and a stronger first pulse.
preset_flutter_desc: Vibration changes rapidly by small amounts near your chosen intensity.
preset_tingle_bed_desc: Steady e-stim with vibration rising and falling smoothly every 4 seconds.
preset_breath_together_desc: Vibration rises and falls every 10 seconds. E-stim follows one second later.
preset_counter_breath_desc: Vibration rises while e-stim falls, and the other way round.
preset_heart_accent_desc: A vibration heartbeat, with a soft e-stim swell on every fourth beat.
preset_split_pulse_desc: Steady e-stim with one vibration pulse per second.
preset_split_swell_desc: A low, steady vibration. E-stim rises over 6 s and eases back over 3 s.
preset_climb_together_desc: Vibration gets stronger in steps. E-stim follows one step behind.
preset_toggle_desc: Vibration plays for 8 seconds, gradually changes to e-stim for 8 seconds, then changes back.
preset_stroke_tingle_desc: Quick vibration waves, about 1.4 per second, with e-stim rising and falling alongside.
preset_tide_pair_desc: E-stim rises and falls with the two vibration waves.
preset_edge_pair_desc: Vibration and e-stim build for 30 seconds. E-stim reaches its peak while vibration stays strong, then both pause for 15 seconds.
preset_finale_desc: Vibration and e-stim build over three minutes. Vibration adds pulses, both reach a peak, then fade slowly.
preset_gen_shape_desc: Choose a wave, breath, pulse, smooth pulse or heartbeat, then set cycle length and intensity variation.
preset_gen_rhythm_desc: Set tempo, beat count, long and short spacing, and first-beat intensity.
preset_gen_drift_desc: The intensity changes smoothly and at random around the level you set.
preset_gen_pink_desc: The intensity rises and falls without a fixed rhythm.
preset_gen_surprise_desc: A steady pulse that now and then accents, skips a beat or pauses.
preset_gen_wander_desc: Smoothly switches between built-in patterns, each lasting 20–60 seconds by default, with adjustable timing.
preset_gen_edge_desc: Vibration builds, stays near its peak, then pauses. The timing varies, and the peak rises a little each round.
preset_gen_arc_desc: Starts gently, builds, holds, adds peaks, then fades, ending at your set time.
update_ready: An opentoys update is ready. Updating reloads this page and disconnects devices.
favourites_empty: No favourites yet. Tap the star on a pattern to add it here.
limit_above80_text: Above 80 %, e-stim is much stronger. Raise the maximum in small steps, then recalibrate e-stim.
limit_above80_box: I accept the risks of e-stim above 80 %.
welcome_privacy: Usage history and settings stay in this browser, with no uploads or sign-up.
hint_tau_s: Higher values make intensity change more slowly.
hint_p: The chance, on each beat, of an accent, a skipped beat or a pause.
hint_duty: How much of each cycle the pulse lasts.
hint_duty_shape: How much of each cycle the pulse lasts. Applies only to Pulse.
hint_k: The beats are spread as evenly as possible over the steps.
hint_spread: How far intensity varies above and below your setting.
hint_creep: How much higher the peak gets each round.
device_about: A ring with vibration and e-stim (gentle electrical stimulation).
unsupported_title_device: This browser can't connect to the device
welcome_connect_several: Connect the devices you want now, and the others later.
coyote_about: An e-stim unit using electrode pads on channels A and B.
coyote_supported: For DG-LAB Coyote 3.0, choose the Bluetooth name starting with 47L121000.
coyote_connect_hint: Switch the device on. Connecting sends no e-stim.
coyote_lost_advice: If output continues after connection loss, switch off the device itself.
coyote_error_connect_failed: Couldn't connect. Check the device is on and nearby, then retry.
coyote_error_not_supported: Unsupported device. For DG-LAB Coyote 3.0, select a name starting with 47L121000.
coyote_error_recovery: DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 is in update mode. Switch it off and on, then reconnect.
coyote_stop_connected: Playback ended in opentoys on reconnection.
coyote_stop_disconnect: Playback ended in opentoys on disconnection.
coyote_stop_link_lost: Connection lost. Playback ended in opentoys.
coyote_stop_not_answering: Device not responding. Playback ended in opentoys.
coyote_stop_write_failed: Couldn't send commands. Playback ended in opentoys.
coyote_stop_page_hidden: Leaving the page ended playback in opentoys.
coyote_left_page: Playback ended in opentoys when you left. It won't resume automatically.
coyote_locked_list: Set up DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 to play these patterns.
coyote_locked_pattern: Set up DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 to play this pattern.
coyote_waveform_shown: Shows {time}. Strength is each pulse's level within your set intensity. Pulse rate is pulses per second.
coyote_waveform_label: Waveform of {name}. It shows strength and pulse rate over time.
coyote_start_note: It starts at 0. Raise the intensity when you are ready.
coyote_pick_first: Choose a pattern to start this channel.
coyote_added_note: Set to {set}. Slow increase has added {added}.
coyote_at_zero: At 0. Raise the intensity when you are ready.
coyote_pauses_help: Plays for {min} to {work} seconds, then pauses for {min} to {pause} seconds, at random.
coyote_increase_help: Adds 1 every {every} seconds while playing, up to {upTo} above your intensity and never above your maximum.
coyote_more_both: Timing and increase amounts apply to both channels. Switches affect this channel only.
coyote_setup_needs_device: Switch on and connect the device to set it up.
coyote_setup_channel_help: Put the pads for {channel} in place and press Start. It starts at 0. Raise it step by step to a comfortable maximum, no higher than {cap}.
coyote_setup_dial_note: You can also use the device's wheel. Pause after each step.
coyote_setup_nothing: No channel maximum set. Device remains disabled.
coyote_setup_confirm_text: Each channel starts at 0 and stays within its maximum.
coyote_limit_max_help: Lower channel maximums here. To raise them, repeat set-up and feel the new levels. A maximum of 0 disables that channel.
coyote_limit_burst_help: How much a burst adds while you hold the button. It never goes above the maximum and ends after 15 seconds.
coyote_above100_text: Higher intensity means stronger e-stim. Repeat set-up to raise the maximum one step at a time.
coyote_above100_box: I accept the risks of a maximum above 100.
coyote_leave: Switching apps or tabs, or locking your phone, ends this device's playback in opentoys. It won't resume automatically.
coyote_safety_chest: Never place pads on the chest, head or neck, or across the chest (for example, one on each arm).
coyote_safety_skin: Don't place pads on broken or irritated skin.
coyote_safety_pads: Switch off the device before moving or removing pads.
coyote_safety_start: Start at 0 and raise the intensity slowly.
coyote_safety_never: Never use it while sleeping or driving.
coyote_safety_stop: If anything hurts or feels wrong, press Stop now. If output continues, switch off the device itself.
cw_steady_desc: Constant strength. Adjust overall output with Intensity.
cw_slow_breath_desc: Strength rises and falls smoothly, once every 0.8 seconds.
cw_double_tap_desc: Two quick bursts, then a half-second pause.
cw_rising_tone_desc: Full strength while the pulses slow down from 100 to 10 per second over 3 seconds, then it starts again.
cw_falling_tone_desc: Full strength while the pulses speed up from 10 to 100 per second over 3 seconds, then it starts again.
cw_tremble_desc: Very fast on-off bursts, 20 per second.
cw_step_in_desc: Strength alternates between medium and full while the pulses slow down in steps from 100 to 20 per second over 4 seconds.
cw_staircase_desc: Strength climbs in five steps over half a second, then starts again.
cw_surge_desc: For 2 seconds it alternates between half strength at 50 pulses per second and full strength at 14 per second. Then it holds full strength for 1 second.
cw_flutter_desc: Strength alternates between full and low. Each pair lasts 0.1 seconds.
cw_tide_desc: Strength rises and falls once a second, pausing briefly every five waves.
coyote_device_keeps: DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 retains each enabled channel's maximum for its wheel too, until an app changes it.
coyote_safety_contact: Keep pads flat against the skin and separate from each other.
coyote_safety_not: Don't use it if you are pregnant, on numb skin, or in the bath or shower.
coyote_safety_break: Take breaks, and limit each spot to 30 minutes at a time.
coyote_safety_maker: Follow the device and pad instructions too.
own_risk: You are responsible for your safety and use opentoys entirely at your own risk. Its developers accept no liability.
setup_agree: I have read and accept these safety notes, and none of the exclusions applies to me.
setup_hold_hint: Press and hold + to raise it steadily.
preview_notice: Devices marked Preview play on screen only.
orb_label: A light that shows what is playing
orb_caption: The light's body shows vibration, its threads e-stim.
ring_estim_follows: E-stim plays when the pattern has it.
ring_setup_vib_help: Wear the device. Raise vibration and confirm the lowest level you feel, then your comfortable maximum.
ring_setup_estim_help: Raise e-stim and confirm the lowest level you feel, then your comfortable maximum.
ring_setup_floor_marked: Lowest felt: {floor}. Raise to a comfortable maximum, up to {cap}.
ring_setup_ask_help: E-stim needs set-up, available later in Control or Settings.
ring_setup_needed_help: Accept the safety notes before playback.
devices_help_settings: Show only content for these devices.
data_import_note: Imported settings cannot enable devices or e-stim, or approve higher limits.
